data.title: Identity: kadence is a reputation project with a pre-set switch to a company; 'no server, no account, no network' is a property of the kadence CLI and its format, not of every product built on it
data.why: Evidence today cannot carry a company: G1 is 0, Probe B has not reached five conversations, E1 and E2 are unrun, the founder is solo and technical work is paused for outreach. Declaring a company now would let a hosted product eat the hours the pre-mortem names as the root cause. Declaring reputation forever would close the door DEC-63 and the accelerator deck already open, against evidence not yet gathered. So: reputation now, and the switch is fixed in advance rather than argued later. kadence becomes a company the day either (a) E2 passes, at least 2 of the first 6 organisations pay for a pilot, or (b) the owner accepts an accelerator or investor offer; that day is a new decision superseding this one. Applying to accelerators and pitching is allowed before the switch, because it is discovery. Scoping the promise now is true on both paths: the CLI, its file format and its hooks never require a server, an account or a network, never phone home, and no core feature moves behind a paid line. A paid org view, if it exists, is a separate opt-in product and may be hosted; it says so wherever it is offered. Until the switch no hosted code is written (DEC-63 point 3 stands).
data.rejected: Company now, hosted org view as the business: G1 is 0 and E1 is unrun; a server before evidence repeats strategy section 2 (every free hour went to code) and turns a solo founder into an operator and GDPR processor; Reputation project forever, no paid line: decides against evidence not yet gathered, contradicts DEC-63 and the deck's ask, and leaves the accelerator conversation with no honest answer; No server as a property of everything named kadence, paid included: forces the org view into the GitHub Action shape before Q-M3 has answered App vs Action (KAD-108), and the promise would have to be broken later rather than scoped now; Leave it as a slide: the elephant in monetization-discovery section 7 exists because identity was never written down; an unwritten identity is renegotiated in every plan
